info.title: Sprout Social API
info.description:
OpenAPI description of the Sprout Social public API at `https://api.sproutsocial.com`.

Covers the **20 endpoints** used by MCP-style integrations (metadata, analytics, messages, listening, publishing, media, cases) — the same surface as [oliverames/sprout-mcp-server](https://github.com/oliverames/sprout-mcp-server).

## Authentication
Send `Authorization: Bearer <token>` on every request. Tokens may be:
- **API token** — Settings → Global Features → API → API Token Management
- **OAuth 2.0 JWT** — machine-to-machine or user auth via Sprout identity (`https://identity.sproutsocial.com/oauth2/.../v1/token`)

Also send `Accept: application/json` and `Content-Type: application/json` (except media uploads, which use `multipart/form-data`).

## Rate limits
- **60** requests per minute
- **250,000** requests per month

## Filter DSL
Many POST endpoints take a `filters` array of Sprout DSL strings, e.g. `customer_profile_id.eq(123, 456)`, `created_time.in(2024-01-01...2024-02-01)`, `text.match(blue OR red)`, `network.neq(FACEBOOK)`.

## Path shape
`/v1/{customer_id}/...` except client metadata (`GET /v1/metadata/client`).

Canonical docs: https://api.sproutsocial.com/docs/

post.description:
Aggregate owned-profile metrics by day over a date range.

**Required filters:** `customer_profile_id.eq(...)` (max 100 profiles) and `reporting_period.in(start...end)` (max 1 year).

Default page size 1000. Total results capped at 10,000.

post.description:
Post-level metrics and content fields for sent posts.

**Typical filters:** `customer_profile_id.eq(...)` (max 100) and `created_time.in(...)`.

Default page size 50. For >10K results use guid-cursor pagination: sort by `guid:asc` and filter `guid.gt(last_guid)`.

post.description:
Query inbox messages with filters for profiles, groups, date ranges, post types, tags, language, and sender GUIDs.

Requires filters. Either use `message_id.eq(...)` alone (max 100), or combine `group_id` / `customer_profile_id` with `created_time` (and optional filters).

Cursor pagination via `page_cursor` / `paging.next_cursor` (no page index).

post.description:
Create a draft publishing post for one or more profiles in a group.

**Only `is_draft: true` is supported.** Approve/publish in the Sprout UI.

Drafts fan out: one calendar post per profile (and per scheduled time). Response objects represent network-specific future posts.

Supported networks: Instagram Business/Creator, Facebook Pages, Threads, X, LinkedIn, YouTube, TikTok, Pinterest, Google My Business.

post.description:
Upload media in a single request (< 50 MiB) or download from a public URL.

Send `multipart/form-data` with either `media` (file bytes) or `media_url` (public http/https URL).

Returns `media_id` (usable for ~24 hours unless attached to a post) and `expiration_time`.

May return **202** while processing; retry until 200.

parameters.name: customer_id
parameters.description: Sprout customer ID. Discover via GET /v1/metadata/client.

media_url.description: Public URL of media to download

post.description:
Start a multipart upload for files > 50 MiB or long URL downloads.

Send `multipart/form-data` with `media` (first 5 MiB part) or `media_url`.

Returns `submission_id` for continue/complete steps. Must finish within 24 hours.

parameters.description: Sprout customer ID. Discover via GET /v1/metadata/client.

media.description: First media part (exactly 5 MiB unless this is the entire file)

media_url.description: Public URL to download (then complete via GET submission)

post.description:
Upload subsequent parts of a multipart media file.

Part numbers start at **2**. Each part (except the last) must be exactly 5 MiB (5,242,880 bytes).

Success returns **200** with an empty body.

post.description:
Query support and feedback cases.

**Required:** either `case_id.eq(...)` alone (max 100), or at least one date filter (`created_time`, `updated_time`, or `latest_activity_time`) with max **7-day** range.

Optional filters: status, priority, type, queue_id, assigned_to/by, created_by, message_id, tag_id (eq/neq).

Cursor pagination via `page_cursor` / `paging.next_cursor`.

BearerAuth.description: API token from Sprout Settings → Global Features → API, or OAuth access token from Sprout identity.

next_cursor.description: Pass as page_cursor on the next request

network_metadata.description: Optional network-specific fields (e.g. address, store_code for Google/Facebook locations)

availability_time.description: How far back data is available (ISO string or epoch ms depending on response)

filters.description: Sprout DSL filters. Must include customer_profile_id and reporting_period.

metrics.description: Metric names for the network(s). See Sprout metrics docs.

filters.description: Sprout DSL filters (customer_profile_id, created_time, guid.gt for cursor pagination, etc.)

fields.description: Message fields to return. If omitted, only guid is returned.

sort.description: Sort specs as field:direction, e.g. created_time:asc or guid:asc

timezone.description: ICANN timezone for date filters (responses remain UTC)

filters.description: Required. group_id, customer_profile_id, created_time, action_last_update_time, post_type, tag_id, language_code, from.guid, or exclusive message_id.

fields.description: Fields to return; default guid only

filters.description: DSL filters: created_time, network, sentiment, text.match, language, location, themes, visual_media.exists, distribution_type, profile.eq/neq, metric comparisons

dimensions.description: e.g. created_time.by(day), created_time.by(month), sentiment, network, language, location.country, visual_media.media_type, distribution_type, explicit_label

scheduled_times.description: UTC ISO-8601 times; seconds rounded down to nearest minute

customer_profile_ids.description: Profiles must belong to the same group

is_draft.description: Must be true; only draft creation is supported

filters.description: Either case_id.eq alone, or date filter(s) max 7 days plus optional status/priority/type/queue/assignee/tag filters
